menu_sin_mios: You don't have radials of your own yet
menu_centrar: Bring the menu back under the mouse
config_nota_orden: Drag the slots to change the order. Number 1 is at the top and the rest go clockwise.
config_icono_ninguno: No icon: the first letter of the text is shown.
config_buscar_icono: Search icon (for example: cube, light, uv)
config_buscar_comando: Search a command (for example: pivot, freeze, extrude)
config_estante_ayuda: Pick a button from any shelf: its command, icon and text are copied.
config_codigo_ayuda: Type or paste the code here. It runs as is when the button is pressed and undoes in one step with Ctrl+Z.
config_vacio_ayuda: This button does nothing. It looks dimmed in the menu.
config_estado_sin_comando: Choose a command from the list.
config_estado_codigo: Use “Try this button” to check that the code works.
ajustes_ayuda: Changes show in the menu right away. Size and opacity are saved with the active radial.
ajustes_velocidad_ayuda: Longest time between the two Tabs. If the menu is hard to open, raise it; if it opens by accident, lower it.
gestor_sin_mios: None yet. Duplicate one or save your changes.
gestor_borrar_pregunta: Delete the radial “{nombre}”? This can't be undone.
gestor_descartar: The active radial has unsaved changes. Discard them?
comando_anotacion: Radial: shows or hides the menu
iniciado: Radial {version} ready: press Tab twice quickly over a viewport to show or hide the menu.
accion_no_existe: Radial: the button “{nombre}” uses the command {comando}, which doesn't exist in this Maya version.
accion_error: Radial: the button “{nombre}” failed: {error}. Details in the Script Editor.
comprobar_avisos: There are warnings, check the list.
comprobar_maya_aviso: Maya {version}: Radial is made for Maya 2026 and 2027.
comprobar_tab_ok: Double Tab active (at most {ms} ms between presses).
comprobar_tab_aviso: Double Tab isn't active. Reload radial_plugin in the Plug-in Manager.
comprobar_boton_aviso: Button {numero}: the command {comando} doesn't exist in this Maya version.
ayuda_texto:
Show or hide: put the mouse over a viewport and press Tab twice quickly.

Quick gesture: press Tab, Tab and hold the second one; move the mouse towards a button and release.

Use a button: move the mouse to a dot and click. The menu stays on screen until the next double Tab.

Move: drag from the centre (or from the pill's dots). It remembers where you leave it.

Change the buttons: right-click the centre, or Radial > Configure buttons. You can also drag a search result, a shelf button or a button from another menu onto it.

Size, shape, theme and speed: Radial > Settings.

Save and share: Radial > Radials. Export a .radial file or a class pack and your students import it.
instalado_texto:
Radial {version} is installed and will load every time you open Maya.

Put the mouse over a viewport and press Tab twice quickly to see the menu.
buscador_asignado: Radial: “{texto}” is now on button {numero}. Save the radial to keep it.
ajustes_buscador_casilla: Show the action search bar under the menu
radial_bloqueado_aviso: Radial: “{nombre}” is locked by the teacher. To change it, make your own copy from Configure buttons.
config_interruptor_ayuda: A toggle turns something on or off, and the button glows green while it's on.
config_estado_python_ayuda: Optional: Python that returns True or False, e.g. cmds.snapMode(q=True, grid=True)
config_carpeta_ayuda: A folder holds 6 more buttons. Clicking it in the menu opens them; the centre goes back.
config_abrir_carpeta: Open folder to edit its buttons
ajustes_carpetas_ayuda: Lets a button be a folder with 6 more buttons inside.
ajustes_automatico_ayuda: Switches radial by itself depending on Maya's workspace and the selection mode (vertices, faces...).
ajustes_aprendizaje_ayuda: When you hover a button, a card explains what it does and its shortcut.
ajustes_clase_ayuda: Shared folder (network, Drive...) with the teacher's radials. They appear under Radials › Class.
reglas_ayuda: Choose which radial turns on in each case. The selection mode wins over the workspace. With unsaved changes the radial doesn't switch.
exportado_bloqueado: Radial: exported locked to {ruta}. Put it in the class folder.
aprendizaje_carpeta: Folder: click to see its buttons
menu_clase_vacia: The class folder has no radials
ajustes_extra_casilla: Show another floating pill, separate from the menu
ajustes_extra_ayuda: Always on screen (it doesn't open with double Tab), with its own buttons, size and orientation. Move it from its dots; right-click them to configure it.
extra_error: Radial: couldn't show the extra pill ({error}).
ajustes_atajo_ayuda: Optional, on top of double Tab (for example Ctrl+Alt+R). It needs Ctrl, Alt or Cmd and never takes a shortcut Maya already uses.
atajo_ocupado: Maya already uses that shortcut for “{comando}”. Choose another one.
atajo_no_valido: That shortcut won't work: use Ctrl, Alt or Cmd plus a key.
atajo_asignado: Radial: the shortcut {atajo} shows or hides the menu.
grabar_titulo: Radial · Button from what I just did
grabar_ayuda: These are the last commands Maya wrote in the Script Editor (newest at the bottom). Tick the ones to keep: the button repeats them in that order and they undo in one step with Ctrl+Z.
grabar_nombre_pista: Button name (leave empty to use the last command's)
grabar_vacio: There are no commands to keep yet. Open the Script Editor (Windows › General Editors › Script Editor), do what you want to repeat and come back. If no commands appear, turn on History › Echo All Commands in the Script Editor.
menu_grabar: Create a button from what I just did...
paquete_fijar_pregunta:
The pack holds your menu, your extra pill (if it's on) and your options.

Do you want to lock the options? If you leave it in the class folder, students using that folder get these options and can't change them.
paquete_exportado: Radial: class pack exported to {ruta}. Share it or leave it in the class folder.
paquete_importado: Radial: pack “{nombre}” imported. Its radials are yours now and its options are applied.
ajustes_fijada: Your teacher has locked this option in the class folder.
ajustes_fijadas_nota: Your teacher has locked some options in the class folder. Yours come back if you remove the folder.
reto_ayuda: Press this tool's keyboard shortcut in Maya.
reto_perfecto: Perfect! You don't need the menu for these any more.
reto_sin_atajos: There are no tools with shortcuts to practise yet. Use the menu for a while and come back.
ajustes_aspecto_ayuda: The accent is the colour of a button when you hover it and of the selected search result. Theme and language are yours: they don't change the radials.
